title: Proposal Microsite
subtitle: Turn a prospect brief into an interactive deal summary your client actually wants to read.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: Calloway Industries — company profile, stakeholder map, 4 pain points ($8.35M impact), proposed solution, 3-year ROI model (215%), 2 case studies, competitive context

learning_objectives: Choose a stack that creates a sales-grade visual experience — font, layout, and colour are persuasion tools
Read a prospect brief and identify what each stakeholder needs to see before they sign
Validate your prompt to ensure the ROI story and stakeholder messaging are both present before building
Build a proposal microsite that makes the value case impossible to miss
Deliver a self-contained HTML file a sales rep can open from their laptop in any client meeting
